prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished full-screen MIRON fitness product UI mockup, NOT a collage, no browser/device frame, no explanation outside the app. Russian UI, clean readable Manrope-like text, consistent thin stroke icons and geometric spaced MIRON wordmark exactly like reference. Friendly premium soft animated-film 3D art, no comic outlines, no lime double slashes. Calm practical adult fitness companion. Content must be comfortably readable at actual app scale. Only one selected companion per screen, no theme/companion switches, no personality tags, no nested cards. Anatomy: every depicted human has exactly TWO arms/two hands/two legs, no duplicated limbs or faces. Keep hands simple and separated, ideally show portrait avatars rather than a large full-body person in dense task views. Respect safe areas and large 48px touch targets. All numbers are illustrative mock data.
Visual system: warm pearl off-white #fffafb background, white surfaces, deep charcoal typography, subtle blush #fce8ef highlights, raspberry #c32662 actions. ACCOUNT XP BAR REMAINS CORAL #ff977f, exactly the same XP system as dark version. No all-screen pink filter or giant character background. Match the supplied light Lika dashboard's Manrope type, icons, airy readable spacing.
Portrait mobile1000x2000, EXPLAINABLE PLAN CHANGES before workout start. Header back 'Изменения плана'. Small user bubble 'Лика, сегодня хочу полегче'. Small Lika face avatar, no body/hands, reply 'Сократим объём. Вот что предлагаю поменять.' Main title 'Что изменится'. Clear side-by-side comparison columns 'Было' and 'Станет', legible per exercise row: 'Жим гантелей лёжа' '3 подхода → 2 подхода'; 'Жим ногами' '3 подхода → 2 подхода'; 'Планка' '3 подхода → 2 подхода'. Untouched row 'Тяга горизонтального блока · без изменений' and 'Ягодичный мост · без изменений' muted but readable. Compact time estimate 'Около 40 мин → около 30 мин'. Small note 'Это предложение. План изменится после подтверждения.' Strong raspberry 'Принять изменения', secondary 'Оставить как было'. No automatic application, no extra XP, no color-coded shame or crossing out already completed work. Clean positive white/rose style, plenty of space for actual diff, no full mascot background.
